content: निर्हरणम् .²1 Carrying out dead bodies to be burnt, carrying corpses to the funeral pile; तस्य निर्हरणादीनि … … युधिष्ठिरः कारायित्वा <ls>Bhāg. 1. 9. 46</ls>. .²2 Taking forth, carrying or drawing out, extracting, removal. .²3 Rooting up, extirpation, destruction. .²4 An antidote (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>विषाचा उतारा</ns>); तांस्तान् विषविशेषांश्च तत्तन्निर्हरणानि च <ls>Śiva B. 30. 20</ls>.
